Prevent pauses when changing emulation speed

Prevent CoreAudio pauses when changing emulation speed. Enqueue
completed buffers in FIFO order instead of scheduling them with
timestamps from an old queue, and remove the per-buffer timeline
allocation.

Track buffer ownership under the same mutex in the producer and playback
callback. Register pending buffers before enqueueing so a fast callback
cannot finish before the bookkeeping, and wait on a condition variable
instead of polling for space.

Keep the buffer count tied to the allocated array during cleanup and
roll back pending state if enqueueing fails.
